name: Velmont Design Studio
notes:
Header logo is a <picture>: WebP source velmont-main.webp (4000x2000) with PNG fallback velmont-main.png (20001x10001, ~1 MB) - the PNG is the largest original. No SVG exists (velmont-main.svg returns 404). Footer uses a white version, velmont-white.png (20000x10000). Accent is the border colour of the outlined 'ENQUIRE' nav button (no filled buttons in the header). Headings: Manrope; body: Inter; Cormorant Garamond and The Seasons are also loaded. Favicon: favicon-192.png (192x192) is larger than apple-touch-icon.png (180x180), so the 192 version is used. Footer background #1a1a1a. Original image files are NOT included in this package: the build workspace cannot reach this site directly and the browser channel cannot transfer binary files. Run fetch_assets.sh (in the brand-assets root) to download the originals listed in sources.txt into this folder unchanged.
